newsitem.title: USA: Humana to sell HMO California to HealthMax.
newsitem.headline: Humana to sell HMO California to HealthMax.

text.p: Humana Inc said Monday it signed a definitive agreement to sell its California health maintenance organization, HMO California, to HealthMax Inc.
The company said HMO California has less than than 10,000 members in four southern California counties, a small percentage of Humana's California membership.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Humana president and chief operating officer Gregory Wolf said in a statement that the deal is consistent with Humana's strategy of concentrating its growth in certain core markets where Humana HMO members comprise a significant share of the population, while divesting HMOs that lack large market share.
